description_en: Removes projects from the scope of a project authorization. This operation can be called only when the ScopeType parameter returned by the GetProjectAuthorization operation is 2
description_zh: 移除项目授权范围项目。仅当通过GetProjectAuthorization接口获取到的对应项目授权中ScopeType参数返回值为2时可调用本接口
name: DetachProjectsFromProjectAuthorization

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host. 
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。 
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The project authorization ID.
You can call the ListProjectAuthorizations operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
项目授权ID。
您可以调用ListProjectAuthorizations接口获取该参数
parameters.name: authorization_id

parameters.help_en:
The array of project IDs to remove from the project authorization.
You can call the GetProjectAuthorization operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要从项目授权中移除的项目ID数组。
您可以调用GetProjectAuthorization接口获取该参数
parameters.name: project_ids

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
